entries.testTitle: [TC-GEN-006] Select two available seats and verify dynamic counts and total price @smoke @regression
entries.rootCause: Calculated ticket total includes an erroneous +$15.00 phantom surcharge (Injected Defect BUG-02: wrong_total_price).

entries.testTitle: [TC-GEN-007] Prevent selection of pre-booked seats on the 10x10 seat map @regression
entries.rootCause: Pre-booked seat button remained interactive and allowed selection instead of staying disabled (Injected Defect BUG-01: booked_seat_selectable).

entries.testTitle: [TC-GEN-009] Reject invalid credit card number and CVV on payment checkout @regression
entries.rootCause: Payment API accepted malformed card number ("1234" / "9999") and CVV without returning validation error (Injected Defect BUG-07: invalid_card_accepted).
